definitions.gloss: annual amount; yearly fee; per-year sum
definitions.explanation: A total sum of money calculated, charged, or paid on a per-year basis, commonly used for subscriptions, insurance, and salary figures.

examples.japanese: {年額|ねんがく}で{支払|しはら}う。
examples.english: To pay on a yearly basis.

examples.japanese: このサービスの{年額|ねんがく}は{一万円|いちまんえん}です。
examples.english: The annual fee for this service is 10,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {保険料|ほけんりょう}を{月額|げつがく}から{年額|ねんがく}に{変更|へんこう}すると{少|すこ}し{安|やす}くなる。
examples.english: Switching the insurance premium from monthly to annual makes it a little cheaper.

notes:
A compound of {年|ねん} (year) and {額|がく} (amount). Used to express the total amount of money charged, earned, or paid over the span of one year. Common in financial, insurance, subscription, and tax contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年額|ねんがく}プラン: annual plan
- {年額|ねんがく}{料金|りょうきん}: annual fee/rate
- {年額|ねんがく}で{計算|けいさん}する: to calculate on an annual basis
- {年額|ねんがく}{換算|かんさん}: annualized equivalent

RELATED WORDS:
- {月額|げつがく}: monthly amount — the monthly counterpart
- {日額|にちがく}: daily amount — the daily counterpart
- {総額|そうがく}: total amount — the grand total regardless of time period
- {年収|ねんしゅう}: annual income — specifically refers to income/earnings
